files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: Build a station flow report: for every station in stations.csv, the number of trips that started there, the number that ended there, and net_flow = ends minus starts (0 for stations without trips). `result` should be a table indexed by station_code with the columns starts, ends and net_flow, sorted by net_flow from highest to lowest.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv and stations.csv (codes as text); for every station in stations.csv count trips with that start_station (starts) and with that end_station (ends), net_flow = ends - starts, 0 counts for stations without trips; indexed by station_code, sorted by net_flow descending (ties in any order).

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros
